source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The debug and opt macOS AArch64 jobs select macosx64-aarch64-libotr. The corresponding toolchain passes macosx64-aarch64, whose build branch uses aarch64-apple-darwin and emits lib/libotr.dylib. The same patch removes the test expected-failure predicate. The unchanged smoke test checks only that the loaded library exposes otrl_version. These source checks do not establish artifact execution, ABI compatibility, or a cryptographic result.
title: macOS AArch64 builds fetch the AArch64 libotr artifact
